usage.daily: Use step=86400 on UTC midnight boundaries (00:00:00 UTC). Expression uses a non-overlapping 1d window.
usage.metadata: Aggregate counts only; query [end-86400,end] step=86400 on UTC midnight boundaries and retain final result.
usage.attestations: The four attested/proof IDs are gateway-computed descriptors, not source Prometheus metrics. They revalidate private process-epoch attestations and expose aggregate public version labels only across completed UTC day boundaries.
usage.verified_binary: Cohort binary routes require a valid fingerprint-verified recorded state hash matched to fresh CPU identity by member, PID, start ticks and boot ID. CPU source age must be in [0,180) seconds. The collector additionally accepts only approved public binary hashes.

postprocessing: Collector still applies the 90% population coverage test and rolling 31-day denominator, null masking, per-relay normalization and midrank reference calculation. Fetch the required prior windows in bounded requests; the gateway only returns reviewed raw aggregates.
